claim: The demo uses sample data and saves no edits.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter from landing, edit a name, then reload

claim: The landing sample preview reports the name and mention counts produced by the bundled sample.
sandbox: fresh browser context; read the rendered landing counts, open the demo, and compare them with its rendered name rows

claim: Manuscript text stays on the device, and importing it sends no third-party requests.
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a chapter containing a unique sentinel while recording every request; assert same-origin only and no sentinel in request data

claim: There is no analytics or advertising, and the app does not upload manuscript text or store it in the cloud.
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit landing, demo, app, privacy and terms while recording requests, cookies and browser storage

claim: Works after the first visit without internet.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load demo, wait for service worker, go offline, reload

claim: Exports the name ledger as CSV.
sandbox: demo project; download CSV and assert its header and one row per name

claim: Authors can search, rename, classify, merge, reject and undo suggested aliases, with the matching rule shown.
sandbox: demo project; merge, undo and reject Captain Venn, then rename and classify Mara Venn and find the edit with search

claim: Search finds names by chapter title as well as name and excerpt text.
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a chapter whose unique filename does not occur in its text, then search that title

claim: Authors can add name-linked continuity notes.
sandbox: demo project; add a note to Mara Venn, assert it, then reset demo

claim: Each detected mention opens its source chapter copy.
sandbox: demo project; open Mara Venn evidence and assert the chapter dialog contains its source sentence

claim: Imports Markdown, text and DOCX chapters with Latin, Han, Kana and Hangul names.
sandbox: fresh browser context; import generated Markdown, plain-text and DOCX files and assert extracted entities

claim: The app reads selected chapters without changing source files.
where: landing method, privacy section, empty state, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a generated Markdown chapter and assert its on-disk contents are unchanged

claim: The free edition indexes three files at a time.
sandbox: fresh browser context without a license; import four files and assert only three are indexed

claim: The web edition stores a real index in local browser storage until the author clears it.
sandbox: fresh browser context; import a folder, reload, clear the index, and reload again

claim: A verified $24 owner license removes the three-file limit.
where: landing pricing, workbench license panel, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded valid verification response; return from checkout with a license query, assert immediate verification and import four files

claim: A revoked license returns to the three-file limit.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded revoked-license response; import four files and assert only three are indexed

claim: The purchase link starts at Sociobot, then opens Dodo's hosted checkout; license checks send only the token and no card details enter this app.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded invalid response; inspect the verification method, URL and body, follow the checkout redirect, and check for card fields

claim: The $24 purchase link starts at Sociobot and redirects to Dodo's hosted checkout.
sandbox: live response check; assert HTTP 303 and final Dodo-hosted checkout URL

claim: The landing page shows exact macOS, Windows and Linux desktop installer choices and never offers a mobile download.
sandbox: fresh desktop and mobile browser contexts with recorded release metadata; assert each architecture-labelled link targets its exact asset and mobile opens the desktop download page

claim: The release workflow builds macOS, Windows and Linux installers, plus SHA256SUMS and latest.json.
sandbox: inspect the committed release workflow and manifest generator for each platform and named release artifact
